description: Ten verified exam briefs for 18 November 2026 covering community seed banks, public-sector banks, export support, naval air defence, AMR, health research, inclusive education, rural accountability, climate diplomacy and assistive AI.

stories.title: DIVERSIFARM-India maps 652 community seed banks and releases a capacity-building manual
stories.summary: DIVERSIFARM-India presented a GIS-based atlas profiling 652 community seed banks at a national seminar in New Delhi. Its survey indicates that India has at least 1,000 such community-led institutions. The research outputs also include six governance-based typologies, a policy brief, a ten-point roadmap for Odisha and a manual for establishing and sustaining community seed banks; these are research and capacity-building outputs, not a newly launched government scheme.
key_facts: The digital atlas has mapped 652 community seed banks, while the wider survey estimates at least 1,000 across India.
The core project partners are the M. S. Swaminathan Research Foundation, Chennai, and the Fridtjof Nansen Institute, Norway.
Community seed banks support in-situ conservation, farmer-managed seed systems, agrobiodiversity and resilience of small farmers.
The study identified six typologies based on differing management and governance structures.
stories.exam_link: Revise in-situ and ex-situ conservation, landraces, gene banks, the Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001, and the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare — Community Seed Banks mapped, 18 November 2026

stories.title: Public-sector banks report record first-half profit and lower bad-loan ratios
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry reported that public-sector banks earned an aggregate net profit of ₹1,09,540 crore in the first half of FY 2026-27, 16.9% higher year on year. Aggregate business crossed ₹300 lakh crore for the first time, while gross and net NPA ratios fell to 1.69% and 0.33% respectively as of 30 September 2026. These are reported financial results, not forecasts.
key_facts: Aggregate business reached ₹301.6 lakh crore, growing 15.5% year on year.
Aggregate advances grew 18.8% to ₹136.4 lakh crore and deposits grew 13.1% to ₹275 lakh crore.
Credit growth was 17% in retail, 19.5% in agriculture and 20.4% in MSME loans.
The capital-to-risk weighted assets ratio stood at 16.89%, up 93 basis points year on year.
All public-sector banks reported provisioning coverage ratios above 90%.
stories.exam_link: Revise gross versus net NPA, provisioning coverage ratio, capital adequacy, risk-weighted assets and the role of public-sector banks in financial intermediation.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Finance — PSB performance in H1 FY 2026-27, 18 November 2026

stories.title: Commerce Department broadens four Export Promotion Mission interventions
stories.summary: The Department of Commerce amended four interventions under the Niryat Disha sub-scheme of the Export Promotion Mission: Market Access Support, TRACE and LIFT, with the release describing four amended interventions in total. The changes widen eligibility for travel reimbursement, certification assistance and logistics support, especially for MSMEs and exporters in low export-intensity regions. The amendments were issued on 17 November and officially detailed on 18 November 2026.
key_facts: The eligible preceding-year export-turnover ceiling for airfare reimbursement rose from ₹75 lakh to ₹50 crore.
Airfare reimbursement can reach 95% for micro and small exporters and 80% for other eligible exporters.
TRACE expanded the reimbursable certificate list from 462 to 600.
LIFT coverage expanded from districts in 13 States and Union Territories to 34, and now includes waterways, Land Customs Stations and Integrated Check Posts.
The minimum eligible distance between origin and destination ports was reduced from 200 km to 100 km.
The Cabinet-approved mission has an outlay of ₹25,060 crore for FY 2025-26 to FY 2030-31.
stories.exam_link: Revise export-promotion institutions, MSME constraints, trade facilitation, logistics costs, Integrated Check Posts and the difference between financial and non-financial export support.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Commerce and Industry — Export Promotion Mission guideline amendments, 18 November 2026

stories.title: Defence Ministry signs ₹1,976.40 crore Barak missile-system upgrade contract
stories.summary: The Ministry of Defence signed a ₹1,976.40 crore contract with Israel Aerospace Industries for hardware and software upgrades and obsolescence management of the Barak Point Defence Missile System installed on Indian Navy ships. The contract was concluded under the Other Capital Procurement Procedure and is intended to improve the platforms' anti-air defence capability.
key_facts: The contracting parties are India's Ministry of Defence and Israel Aerospace Industries.
The work covers both hardware and software upgrades as well as obsolescence management.
The system is a point-defence anti-air capability deployed aboard Indian naval platforms.
The reported contract value is ₹1,976.40 crore.
stories.exam_link: Revise point defence versus area defence, naval air-defence layers, capital procurement and the strategic dimensions of India-Israel defence cooperation.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Defence — Barak point-defence system upgrade contract, 18 November 2026

stories.title: India inaugurates World AMR Awareness Week observance with a One Health focus
stories.summary: The Union Health Ministry inaugurated India's national observance of World Antimicrobial Resistance Awareness Week 2026 under the theme 'One Health, One Action: Prevent AMR Now'. The ministry emphasised prescription-based antibiotic use, infection prevention, safe disposal and responsible veterinary use. This was an awareness and coordination observance; it did not announce a new law or scheme.
key_facts: World AMR Awareness Week is observed from 18 to 24 November.
One Health connects human, animal, plant and food-system health with the environment.
India's National Action Plan on AMR 2.0 covers 2025-2029.
The National Programme on AMR Containment is coordinated by the National Centre for Disease Control.
Antibiotics do not treat viral infections such as the common cold and influenza.
stories.exam_link: Revise antimicrobial resistance, antimicrobial stewardship, One Health, zoonoses, infection prevention and the coordinating role of the National Centre for Disease Control.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare — World AMR Awareness Week 2026, 18 November 2026

stories.title: ICMR crosses 100 health-technology transfers and exchanges 20 new licensing agreements
stories.summary: At the third DHR-ICMR Health Research Excellence Summit, ICMR announced that its cumulative technology-transfer deals had reached 100. It exchanged 20 licensing agreements covering eight technologies with nine Indian companies and showcased 17 indigenous health technologies. The summit also launched or released initiatives for health research, disease surveillance and translating evidence into policy.
key_facts: The 20 licensing agreements covered eight technologies and involved nine Indian companies.
The milestone was achieved through the Medical Innovations Patent Mitra initiative launched in March 2025.
ICMR functions under the Department of Health Research in the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
ICMR was established in 1911 and marked 115 years in 2026.
The summit released an AMR annual report and standard operating procedures for laboratories.
stories.exam_link: Revise technology transfer, licensing, patents, translational research and the institutional relationship between ICMR, the Department of Health Research and the Health Ministry.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare — DHR-ICMR Health Research Excellence Summit, 18 November 2026

stories.title: PRASHAST 2.0 screening highlighted during UN disability-rights interaction
stories.summary: The Department of School Education and Literacy briefed the UN Special Rapporteur on measures for inclusive education under Samagra Shiksha. It highlighted PRASHAST, a checklist for early identification of 21 disabilities among children aged 3-18, and said the revamped PRASHAST 2.0 app is integrated with UDISE+. The interaction reviewed existing initiatives rather than creating a new entitlement.
key_facts: PRASHAST 2.0 reportedly reduced teachers' initial-screening time from three days to 15 minutes.
By October 2026, more than six crore children had been screened and over 7.26 lakh schools onboarded.
The ministry reported sensitisation of more than 79 lakh teachers.
Samagra Shiksha interventions include early identification, individual support, accessibility, therapies, skilling and examination facilities.
stories.exam_link: Revise Samagra Shiksha, UDISE+, inclusive education, reasonable accommodation and India's obligations under the Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Education — Interaction with UN Special Rapporteur on disability rights, 18 November 2026

stories.title: Rural Development Ministry issues district ombudsperson and appellate-authority guidelines
stories.summary: The Rural Development Ministry issued guidelines for Ombudspersons and Appellate Authorities under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025. The framework provides district-level grievance redress for matters such as job cards, employment, wages, delay compensation, worksite facilities, muster rolls and denial of statutory entitlements, backed by digital tracking and social-audit participation.
key_facts: A dedicated digital platform will register and track complaints, record proceedings, upload awards and monitor action taken.
Field visits are to be supported by geo-tagged and time-stamped photographs.
Each Ombudsperson is expected to attend at least three social-audit public hearings or Gram Sabhas every month.
The framework covers discrimination, harassment and violations affecting women and vulnerable groups.
stories.exam_link: Revise ombudsman institutions, social audit, Gram Sabha, grievance redress, transparency tools and statutory versus administrative entitlements in rural programmes.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Rural Development — Ombudsperson guidelines under VB-G RAM G, 18 November 2026

stories.title: India's COP31 statement stresses equity, climate justice and CBDR-RC
stories.summary: At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, India called for climate action grounded in equity, climate justice and Common but Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities. The national statement argued that developing countries should not bear a disproportionate burden for historical emissions and stressed equitable access to the remaining carbon budget. These were negotiating positions, not newly adopted COP decisions.
key_facts: COP31 was held under the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change.
CBDR-RC recognises common responsibility for climate protection while differentiating obligations according to responsibility and capability.
India linked higher ambition to delivery of climate-finance obligations and access to the remaining carbon budget.
The statement was delivered at Antalya in Türkiye.
stories.exam_link: Revise the UNFCCC, Conference of the Parties, climate finance, historical responsibility, carbon budgets and the CBDR-RC principle embedded in climate negotiations.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change — India's national statement at COP31, 18 November 2026

stories.title: Government institute and Paraspeak Labs sign MoU for AI-based speech assistance
stories.summary: The Ali Yavar Jung National Institute of Speech and Hearing Disabilities (Divyangjan), Mumbai, signed an MoU with Paraspeak Labs to develop and clinically validate affordable AI-based assistive technology for persons with speech disabilities. The institute will support speech-sample collection and validation for a Hindi impaired-speech dataset intended to improve a device that converts dysarthric speech into clearer speech in real time. The work remains at the development and validation stage, not nationwide deployment.
key_facts: AYJNISHD(D) is an autonomous body under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities.
The department is part of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Paraspeak is described as a patented Made-in-India AI-based assistive device.
The proposed dataset focuses on impaired speech in Hindi.
stories.exam_link: Revise assistive technology, accessible digital design, disability inclusion, clinical validation, speech datasets and the administrative structure of the Social Justice Ministry.
stories.source_title: PIB, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment — AYJNISHD(D)-Paraspeak MoU, 18 November 2026

mcqs.question: How many community seed banks had been profiled in the DIVERSIFARM-India GIS-based atlas announced on 18 November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The atlas had profiled 652 community seed banks; at least 1,000 was the wider survey estimate for India.

mcqs.question: Which pair forms the core partnership leading DIVERSIFARM-India?
mcqs.explanation: The project is led by the M. S. Swaminathan Research Foundation, Chennai, and Norway's Fridtjof Nansen Institute.

mcqs.question: What was the reported net NPA ratio of public-sector banks as of 30 September 2026?
mcqs.explanation: The Finance Ministry reported a net NPA ratio of 0.33%; the gross NPA ratio was 1.69%.

mcqs.question: Under the amended TRACE intervention, the number of certificates eligible for reimbursement increased to what total?
mcqs.explanation: The eligible certificate list was expanded from 462 to 600 to support wider MSME compliance needs.

mcqs.question: Which transport mode was newly added under the amended LIFT intervention of the Export Promotion Mission?
mcqs.explanation: Waterways were added alongside road, rail and air for eligible logistics support.

mcqs.question: The ₹1,976.40 crore Barak missile-system upgrade contract was signed with which company?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Defence signed the Barak point-defence upgrade contract with Israel Aerospace Industries.

mcqs.question: What was the theme of World AMR Awareness Week 2026?
options: One Health, One Action: Prevent AMR Now
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 theme linked coordinated One Health action with immediate prevention of antimicrobial resistance.

mcqs.question: India's National Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance 2.0 covers which period?
mcqs.explanation: The Health Ministry identified NAP AMR 2.0 as the national framework for 2025-2029.

mcqs.question: The 20 licensing agreements exchanged at the DHR-ICMR summit covered how many technologies?
mcqs.explanation: Twenty agreements covering eight technologies were exchanged with nine Indian companies.

mcqs.question: PRASHAST 2.0 is integrated with which national school-information system?
mcqs.explanation: The revamped PRASHAST 2.0 mobile application is integrated with UDISE+.

mcqs.question: PRASHAST is designed for early identification of how many disabilities among children aged 3-18?
mcqs.explanation: The screening checklist covers 21 disabilities among school-going children aged 3-18 years.

mcqs.question: Under the new rural ombudsperson guidelines, what is the minimum monthly attendance expected at social-audit public hearings or Gram Sabhas?
mcqs.explanation: Each Ombudsperson is expected to attend at least three such hearings or Gram Sabhas every month.

mcqs.question: Which climate-negotiation principle did India prominently invoke in its COP31 national statement?
options: Common but Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities
mcqs.explanation: India anchored its statement in CBDR-RC, equity and climate justice.

mcqs.question: AYJNISHD(D), Mumbai, functions under which department?
options: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
Department of School Education and Literacy
mcqs.explanation: AYJNISHD(D) is an autonomous body under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities.

mcqs.question: The Hindi dataset planned under the AYJNISHD(D)-Paraspeak MoU is primarily intended to improve what capability?
options: Real-time conversion of dysarthric speech into clearer speech
Detection of hearing loss from images
mcqs.explanation: The partnership aims to train and validate an assistive system that converts dysarthric speech into clear, intelligible speech in real time.
